items.title: Chase Brown: Quiet in Week 9 win
items.text:
Brown carried the ball nine times for 57 yards and caught all three of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

items.title: Joe Burrow: Another stellar effort in Week 9 win
items.text:
Burrow completed 24 of 29 passes for 271 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons. He added seven yards and a TD on three carries.
